officialLinks.label: Grade scale, GPA formula, AF and administrative grades

helpIntro: UNH uses a 4.0 plus/minus scale. Enter graded UNH semester credits and final grades to estimate your current and projected undergraduate GPA.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate UNH GPA planning. The shared calculator displays three decimals, while UNH calculates the official GPA to two decimal places without rounding. Use the Pass/Fail course type when applicable; graduate and Law records need separate review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.00 grade points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.99. Together, 21.99 / 6 = 3.665 in the planning display; UNH’s official two-decimal calculation is not rounded.

gradeExplanations.F: Standard F counts at 0.00 and its graded credits remain in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.AF: Administrative Failure; treated the same as F in GPA calculation.
gradeExplanations.AU: Audit; no credit and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.IC: Incomplete coursework; excluded until resolved; may become F if not completed by deadline.
gradeExplanations.IA: Continuing course/thesis notation; excluded until replaced by final grade.
gradeExplanations.IX: Grade not reported; excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.NR: Not Resolved pending academic-integrity matter; excluded until resolved.

specialTypes.name: UNH course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Enter UNH graded credits and the final grade.

specialTypes.name: UNH course, Pass/Fail option
specialTypes.note: Choose P or F only. Both are excluded from GPA under the undergraduate Pass/Fail option.

specialTypes.name: Approved external transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer credit does not enter the UNH GPA.

specialTypes.name: Graduate or Law course/record
specialTypes.note: Graduate and Law rules are outside this undergraduate profile.

repeatPolicy.note: For an eligible UNH undergraduate repeat, the former credits and grade points are removed from cumulative GPA and the repeated course is added. Both grades remain visible on the transcript.
